studioPattern.localAdaptation: Early Grow project scaffold with GitHub connection notes; product scope and runtime stack are still TBD.

projectState.summary: Byte 10b adds a deterministic per-player velocity expression layer. `src/expression.ts` calculates bounded expression snapshots from player, beat, event index, and taste-scaled velocity; transport applies the factor to final audible velocity, records it on `MusicalEvent.expression`, exposes latest snapshots at `window.transport.getState().expression.latest`, and renders a `Dynamics` row per player. Timing, pitch, lookahead refill, session-mode behavior, and Ollama output remain unchanged.
